Chore Chart Maker

Build a weekly chore chart for family members — assign chores per day and print it.

Click a cell to cycle through family members. Members:

📖 How to use

  1. Add family members and chores.
  2. Click cells to assign a person to each chore/day.
  3. Edits save automatically.
  4. Click Print Chart for a paper-friendly copy.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I assign chores?

Add family member names, then add chore names. Click any cell to cycle through: empty → member initials assigned. Then print.

How does cell assignment work?

Clicking a cell cycles through family members one by one, then back to empty — tap until the right person shows.

How do I print the chart?

Click Print Chart to open a print-friendly version in a new window.

Is my chart saved?

In this browser's localStorage — private to this device.
